title: Multi-AZ standby or read replica
claim: A Multi-AZ standby takes over behind the same endpoint, and a read replica serves read traffic through its own endpoint.
alt: Two panels. Left, a Multi-AZ deployment: an app server sends reads and writes to one DB endpoint. The endpoint points to the primary DB instance, which copies data synchronously to a standby DB instance. After a failover, the same endpoint points to the standby. Right, a read replica: the app server sends writes to the DB endpoint of the primary and reads to a separate replica endpoint. The primary copies data asynchronously to the read replica.
notes: Pilot for the diagram gate. QA on 2026-10-04: 3 rounds, lint clean. Not checked against the fact canon: ground the two kinds of replication, the endpoint after a failover and the replica endpoint before chapter 26 uses it. The highlight marks the path that each option adds. Known limits: no highlight ring on the standby or the replica, because the ring touched the label 'asynchronous' and the lint did not see it; 'synchronous copy' does not fit between two columns; the endpoints are plain boxes, because no official icon fits.
